title: Tsukihime: The Millennium Castle
alt: A night city under a deep blue sky full of stars. In the middle of it stands a huge castle like blue glass with a light inside: a tower of round storeys of thin upright rods, each storey smaller than the one below, with a skirt of roofs half way up and a thin spire. Long bridges on thin legs hang out from it over the town, and a lower hall with a pointed roof stands at each side. Behind the tower is an enormous pale blue moon. White mist lies at the foot of the castle, with pale city blocks in it and dark roofs with lit windows nearer to us.
summary: A painting of the Millennium Castle from Tsukihime in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the Millennium Castle Brunestud, from Tsukihime, a visual novel by Type-Moon. It is the castle of Arcueid, the princess of the True Ancestors. No one built it: she makes it real by her will. In the new version of the story it stands, on one night, in the middle of the city.
The moon is in the name of the story, which means Moon Princess. No one is in the picture. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
